item.title: How to extract Usage metrics from the Power Platform Admin center (no code)
item.description:
Why did I need this?

Disclaimer, no AI was used to create this blogpost, but it did help me in finding this method.

I have a usecase, where I need all report metrics for usage from the Power Platform admin center. The new log visuals are in preview, and dont (yet at the time of writing this) offer support in exporting these metrics.

There is no PowerShell script way to do this, no endpoint to call using Get (Allthough if you were to try, it wont return anything)
